dct_creator_sm: Barnas, Andrew (University of Victoria, University of Victoria, School of Environmental Studies, ACME Lab). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0990-4666
dct_description_sm: This data deposit documents data management and analyses performed in Barnas et al. Reduced population density in urban deer following immunocontraceptive treatment trial. Journal of Applied Ecology. This study documents the estimation of population density in urban deer using camera trap data, with the primary analyses being spatial mark resight models in R.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Barnas et al. Reduced population density in urban deer following immunocontraceptive treatment trial. Journal of Applied Ecology
